_comment: Model lineage: one entry per client id (provider:model). family groups checkpoints of one model line; parent is the client id this checkpoint was trained from; step is the training step or epoch; trainedOn tags the data. Every run records the entries of the clients it ran, and the index carries family/step so scorecards and compares can follow a line over time. Add your own checkpoints here as you serve them (see docs/serving.md).
